integrity: Formal algebraic proof reconstructed for all Frobenius numbers including F=1; exact-rational independent companion and interpolation tests were executed; no external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a trace identity, not an individual critical-value classification; its proof uses classical Newton identities. Earlier equivalent polynomial-trace formulations and unpublished 2019 related work cannot be excluded.
title: Critical-value traces of numerical-semigroup gap polynomials: a genus-rank law
